#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text: Subject: Filling up the post of General Manager (Region), Food Corporation of India (DS/Director level), Regional Office, Panchkula, Haryana under the Department of Food and Public Distribution on deputation basis.

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: This is regarding filling up of the post of General Manager (Region), Food Corporation of India (DS/Director level), Regional Office, Panchkula, Haryana under the Department of Food and Public Distribution on deputation basis. The above post is a Central Staffing Scheme post to be filled up through the Civil Services Board (CSB) procedure. This post has been identified as a sensitive post and therefore, the tenure of the post as per the extant guidelines of Central Vigilance Commission will be for a period of 3 years.

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: 2. Officers of the rank of Deputy Secretary/Director level from the All India Services or any Organized Services of the Government of India (list enclosed), eligible for appointment under Central Staffing Scheme at DS/Director level are eligible for the above post. Further, having an experience of working with Food Procurement and Public Distribution System related matters may be treated as a desirable experience.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: 3. The above post may be circulated amongst officers eligible to be appointed at DS/Director or equivalent level in the Government of India under Central Staffing Scheme on priority basis. Names of willing and eligible officers who can be spared by the State Governments/Ministries/Departments may be forwarded/mailed(dir.mm@nic.in) to the Department along with Cadre clearance, Vigilance clearance, detailed bio-data (through SUPREMO link: https://supremo.nic.in). For officers working in the cadre, it may also be ensured that the 'Cooling off' after a previous stint on deputation, if any, is completed and the officer is eligible to be appointed on Central Deputation as per instructions. Applications of those eligible officers who are already working on Central Deputation under the Central staffing Scheme/Non-CSS posts of GOI, are required to be forwarded by their respective Ministries/Department, along with the approval of their respective Minister-in-Charge.

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text: 4. The last date for the submission of applications for the above-said post is 02.03.2026. Nominations are to be routed through DOPT online interface (DOPT website>>EO Division> Apply for posts of CSS, CVO and others>>SUPREMO (Choose CSS category through SUPREMO link : https://supremo.nic.in) for those officers who have not yet applied for any other posts online this year. Those officers who have already applied for CSS, CVO or Other posts in SUPREMO can send their willingness for the above post. Nominations/correspondence on the subject may be routed through email id dir.mm@nic.in only.
